scope: Corollary 6.3 (From fixed twists to Frobenius sections) of the manuscript “Prescribed large-volume charges on threefolds with trivial canonical bundle” (preprints/Prescribed-large-volume-charges-on-threefolds-with-trivial-canonical-bundle-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 055 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 84ce978a67015704), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On a smooth geometric fiber in the preceding lemma, let P1 be a perfect complex with ordinary cohomology in degrees [−1, 0]. If H0( H−1 (P1)(j2) ) = 0, then, for either L = Lp or L = L′ p, h0 (F∗ P1 ⊗ L) ≤ C0p3 h0 (P1(j)). (6.4) The twists j, j2 and the constant C0 are those chosen from the fixed geometry in Lemma 6.2.
